description: 1-bit fixed-direction dual-supply level translator, Schmitt-trigger input, 3-state output
note: Pinout txu0101 p.3 (DBV, DCK, DRY, DTQ all the same): VCCA 1, GND 2, A 3, BY 4, OE 5, VCCB 6; txu0101-q1 p.3 same (DCK, DRY). A -> BY when OE high, OE low = BY Z (p.1, p.3). A referenced to VCCA, BY to VCCB; OE works from either supply (VCC(MIN) logic), put in the VCCA domain. Inputs have weak pull-downs (not modeled).

TXU.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V +-0.3 V, VCCB 5 V +-0.5 V, -40 to 85 C (txu0101 p.13; no typical printed); VCCA and VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V on every input (p.5); -q1 p.5 same
